slides.title: Abiy meets Putin in Moscow: what's on the table?
A nuclear power plant
slides.body: Russia's Rosatom and Ethiopia's Nuclear Energy Commission are working on a draft intergovernmental agreement. Signing would start design work. No date has been given.

slides.title: More flights, easier visas
slides.body: Ethiopian Airlines flies Addis Ababa–Moscow six times a week. Both sides are discussing more flights and easier visas for tourists and business travellers. No timeline yet.

slides.title: What to watch
slides.body: A Kremlin aide said Putin meets Abiy on Oct 28 and Eritrea's leadership on Oct 30, separately (TASS). Russia has offered to host Ethiopia–Eritrea talks; none has been announced.

slides.title: Support peaceful dialogue in the region.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.
